name: Who Am I? Exploring the concept of identity in LLMs
description: An automated survey of how large language models locate their own identity, in which 0-2 turns of each interview were served by a different model and subjects were later asked to identify them.

files.description: Roster, families, swap conditions, thread counts, and how far the run has got.

Every numeric result: total and per-model rates with the counts behind them, plus breakdowns by swap condition and model family. Entries with status='pending' are awaiting the qualitative coding pass.
